# solve_poisson_spectral { #mofography.compute.solve_poisson_spectral }

```python
compute.solve_poisson_spectral(atoms, grid_spacing=0.2, epsilon_r=1.0)
```

Solve the Poisson equation using a spectral method for non-orthogonal, periodic systems.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                         | Default    |
|--------------|--------|-------------------------------------|------------|
| atoms        |        | ASE Atoms object                    | _required_ |
| grid_spacing |        | Desired grid spacing in Angstroms   | `0.2`      |
| epsilon_r    |        | Relative permittivity of the system | `1.0`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                              |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | Electrostatic potential (V), grid shape, and cell matrix |
